title: Relay frame size check
responsibility: Determines whether a text or binary frame exceeds the byte limit.

inputs.name: frameTooLarge.message
inputs.description: Text frame or binary ArrayBuffer. Text is measured as UTF-8 bytes.

inputs.name: frameTooLarge.limit
inputs.description: Optional byte limit, defaulting to the protocol’s 262,144 bytes.

outputs.name: frameTooLarge
outputs.description: True only when frame bytes exceed the limit; equal size is accepted. Text-length bounds avoid encoding when the answer is already certain.

examples.subject: frameTooLarge
examples.name: Allow a short text frame below the default byte limit

examples.subject: frameTooLarge
examples.name: Allow text exactly at the default byte limit

examples.subject: frameTooLarge
examples.name: Reject text one byte over the default byte limit

examples.subject: frameTooLarge
examples.name: Allow two-byte UTF-8 text exactly at the default byte limit

examples.subject: frameTooLarge
examples.name: Reject two-byte UTF-8 text one character over the default byte limit

examples.subject: frameTooLarge
examples.name: Reject three-byte UTF-8 text beyond the default byte limit

examples.subject: frameTooLarge
examples.name: Allow a binary frame exactly at the default byte limit

examples.subject: frameTooLarge
examples.name: Reject a binary frame one byte over the default byte limit

examples.name: Allow text exactly at a custom byte limit
